WelcomeModal.title: Welcome to the 1926 Address Book
WelcomeModal.body1: This is a hobby project by <name>Lieuwe Jongsma</name> (Groninger Archieven). The goal is to make the 1926 Groningen adresboek searchable and spatially explorable in an interactive way.
WelcomeModal.disclaimer: Note: This is a work in progress. The link between addresses and map locations may contain errors or gaps due to historical renumbering or extraction differences.
WelcomeModal.mobileNotice: This website works best on a larger screen

map.title: The Map
map.text: This is the map of Groningen today. The marked buildings contain addresses from the 1926 address book. Click on a building to see who lived there.

layers.title: Map Layers
layers.text: Switch here between modern and historical maps from the 1915–1935 period. This allows you to overlay the Groningen of then on the Groningen of now.

search.title: Search
search.text: Search the entire address book by name, address, or occupation. Click on a result to jump directly to the correct page.

scan.title: Page View
scan.text: View the original scanned page from the 1926 address book. Browse through the book and zoom in on the details.

section.title: Sections
section.text: Jump to different parts of the book: the name register, street register, and more.

info.title: More Information
info.text: Click here for more information about the project, the sources, and the historical maps.
